system.description: A decorated soldier with heavy armor and a powerful swing.
system.notes:
Normal | Leader

A decorated soldier with heavy armor and a powerful swing.
Motives & Tactics: Run down, seek glory, show dominance

Difficulty: 15 | Thresholds: 8/14 | HP: 6 | Stress: 4

ATK: +4 | Weapon: Melee | 1d10+5 phy

Experience: High Society +2, Tactics +2

Features

Shield Wall - Passive: While shielding, the Knight gains +2 Difficulty. When they take Severe damage, they lose this benefit until they are next spotlighted.

Heavily Armored - Passive: Reduce physical damage the Knight takes by 3.

Bash - Action: Move up to Close range and make a standard attack. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

For the Realm! - Action: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4+1 allies. While spotlighted this way, their attacks deal half damage.
